utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Morning, everyone. Anyone's weekend plans actually survive that weather? Mine involved the garden. Garden won.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: We got as far as putting the chairs out. Then straight back in again. Proper British spring.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Yeah, lovely. And the charity bake sale on Friday — I reckon that was the last time I was properly warm.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: That charity bake sale on Friday was brilliant. Someone bought my entire tray, which suggests they hadn't tasted one first.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Useful as packing material, those brownies. Stores-approved.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Harsh. Right, Monday the thirteenth, let's get going. Quick distinction between closed stuff and anything we're actually agreeing.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: I finished the repair on the boiler feed pump last night. That's completed, not another repair for today.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Ah, right, fully finished then? I only saw the earlier message.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Yeah, fully finished. Earlier message was before I'd closed it out.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: And I tested the 11kV Switchboard yesterday and it's all fine now. That's another completed one.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Right, so yesterday's test isn't sitting there waiting for someone?

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: No, done. Just giving you the result, really.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: While we're clearing those, I signed off the inspection on the Line 3 Screw and Barrel on Tuesday. That's finished as well.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Good, those are closed. Anything that's just a status update?

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Yeah, saw the pressure on the Forklift Fleet dip for a few minutes, it came back on its own. Just an observation, nothing I'm raising as a job.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Sorry, talked over the end there — it recovered without anyone touching it?

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Exactly. Back on its own. Just mentioning what I saw.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Still waiting on parts for the stretch wrapper, nothing we can do until they arrive. That stays blocked.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Yeah, no change to that status from stores. Not a job we can release.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Same story here: still waiting on parts for the GT1 compressor, nothing we can do until they arrive.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Right, both parked, not actions for today.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: And we were going to replace the belt on the trucks but that's been pushed to next month so ignore it. It's off this list.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Yep, cancelled from this round. Right, the actual jobs.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Marcus, can you write up the near miss at the palletiser by Wednesday? That one's safety critical, straight away.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Sorry, I can't take that. I haven't got the capacity to give the write-up proper attention, and I wasn't there for the bit that matters.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Okay, Olu, can you take that instead — write up the near miss at the palletiser by Wednesday? That one's safety critical, straight away.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Yeah, I'll take it from Marcus. I'll start straight away and get the near miss at the palletiser written up by Wednesday.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Yeah, the near miss itself is the thing we're talking about, not just a general description of how the machine runs.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Understood. That's what I'll write up. I've got the sequence clear.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Olu, can you also book a contractor to look at the turbine two by the 28th? It matters but it's not urgent.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Yep, I'll book a contractor to look at the turbine two by the 28th. That can sit behind the safety write-up.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Just so I've heard that right — booking by the 28th, not saying the contractor has to be standing here by then?

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Correct, the booking by the 28th. We're not setting the visit date in this call.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Fine, agreed. Important, not an urgent call-out.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: And I'll run a function test on the 11kV board on the 3rd.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: That's the separate function test, yeah? Not reopening what Grace said she'd finished yesterday?

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Yeah, separate. Yesterday's completed test stays completed. I'll run this function test on the 11kV board on the 3rd.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Fine, Sarah Okafor for that one. No clash with the completed item from me.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Teams clipped the date for me. On the 3rd, was it?

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: On the 3rd, yeah.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: While we're on the routine bits, I'll swap the filter on the line one HPU by 11am. Low priority, that one.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: That's a routine filter swap, not a new failure then?

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Yeah, routine. Nothing dramatic behind it. I'll have it swapped by 11am, but it's low priority.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Agreed, Grace. Filter on the line one HPU is yours.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: And the spare-parts order is separate from that filter swap, isn't it? Don't want the two getting muddled.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: It is. I'll order spare parts for the Line 1 Hydraulic Power Unit next Tuesday. That's a spare-minute sort of job, not urgent.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Okay, Priya Raman, order spare parts for the Line 1 Hydraulic Power Unit next Tuesday — in the 'if you've got a spare minute' category.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Yeah, exactly. Next Tuesday, and separate from the filter Grace is swapping.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: I'll send the shift handover report round as well, when I've got a spare minute. It's not something everything else needs to stop for.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Thanks, David Whitfield. Yes, if you've got a spare minute — no deadline being added to that.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Lovely. I'll send it round on that basis.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Um, I'll go to Northfield to pick up the replacement parts for the Injection Moulding Line 3 as well. It matters but it's not urgent.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: That's just collecting the replacement parts, yeah? Not rolling fitting them into the same job?

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Yeah, just the trip to Northfield to pick up the replacement parts for the Injection Moulding Line 3. No fitting job in that.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Agreed. Olumide Adeyemi for the Northfield collection for the Injection Moulding Line 3. It matters but it's not urgent.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Yep. No need to turn it into a dash up there.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: And I'll inspect the Boiler Feedwater Pump for leaks. No rush on that one.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: That's separate from the repair Sarah finished last night, then? Just don't want it sounding like the repair's still open.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Yeah, repair's done. I'll inspect the Boiler Feedwater Pump for leaks, that's all. No rush.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Okay, Olumide, that inspection's yours. Separate from the completed repair, and no rush.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: And we're not saying there's a fresh leak reported here, just agreeing the inspection?

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Exactly. Not reporting another fault.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Right. Olu, with those bits on your list, the near miss at the palletiser is the safety-critical one, straight away, written up by Wednesday.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Absolutely. That's first. Contractor booking by the 28th, and the collection and leak inspection aren't urgent.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Good. Blocked work stays blocked, completed work stays closed, and the belt replacement isn't in today's mix. Think that's us.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Cheers, everyone. Brownie feedback has been noted and rejected.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Very professional. Thanks all, bye.
